provenance.runner: loads research.runners.sharded_phasor_store.ShardedPhasorStore directly (round-trip save/load, the exact path the pre-existing bug corrupted)

spotcheck.method: 60 random facts (agent,action,patient) sampled from the SAVED+RELOADED bundle's own shard kb (seed=2), each queried via store.query_patient(agent, action) and compared against the stored patient

query_latency_s.note: measured under this session's heavy concurrent CPU contention (see finding); the O(V*D) codebook-cleanup cost driving this number is CPU-bound work, so the magnitude is directionally real even if the absolute number would be somewhat lower on an uncontended box

conclusion: The vocab-completeness fix (research/runners/_knowledge_core_curate.py's vocab_with_aliases computation) holds at full production scale: 60/60 facts recalled correctly after a genuine save/reload round-trip on the 45,804-fact/37,837-vocab bundle -- the exact round-trip the pre-existing ShardedPhasorStore bug corrupted (0/30 correct) before the fix. Query latency at this vocab size is ~1.1-1.3s, confirming the finding's honest scale/latency tradeoff note.
